entries.detail: Created agent-manifest.json mapping Cape Town GeoHub repository structure. Project is a geospatial decision-support platform with FastAPI backend (app/), React+Vite frontend (frontend/), CI workflows, and existing agent manifests.

All generated artifacts are proposals only. No changes to application source code (app/, frontend/src/, tests/) will be made. Only .github/ directory modifications permitted. Patches generated under patches/ for any suggested code changes.
